name: MCP Bridge (dev)
author: Asekhan + Claude
description: Developer tool. Publishes the mod API and a log buffer on window.__sandustryMcp so the local MCP server (github.com/Asekhan/Sandustry-mcp-bridge) can drive the game through the DevTools port. On every page load it runs the mods' code as it is on disk now (for mod_reload). Opens no port and makes no network calls. Adds no content.
